assertions.title: Restaurant thank-you aliases canonicalize to one public confirmation route

steps.action: Open the legacy restaurant thank-you URL on localhost
steps.expected: The alias redirects to a single canonical public thank-you route

steps.action: Inspect the final destination and visible page state
steps.expected: The canonical route remains guest-facing and preserves required confirmation query params
steps.observed: Final page title was 'Reservation Confirmed · Nab a Table' and the thank-you screen rendered at the canonical /book/thank-you route with guestName and confirmation still present in the URL

steps.action: Check browser console and network capture
steps.expected: No blocking console/runtime issues during canonicalization
steps.observed: No page errors were reported. agent-browser did not retain the initial document redirect in the request log for this navigation, so redirect evidence is based on start URL versus final URL plus the rendered destination

assertions.title: Recovery success strips the token from the final destination URL

steps.action: Open the deterministic recovery harness with active fixture and autoStart enabled
steps.expected: The harness should drive a successful recovery into an entitled internal booking destination
steps.observed: The harness triggered /bookings/recover?access_token=<redacted>&next=%2Fbookings%2F22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222 and then navigated to /bookings/22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222

steps.action: Observe the final destination after recovery
steps.expected: Recovery should finish on the entitled booking destination with no token remaining in the final URL
steps.observed: The flow did not remain on booking detail. It redirected onward to /auth/signin?redirectedFrom=%2Fbookings%2Frecover%3Fnext%3D%252Fbookings%252F22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222

steps.action: Check visible result, console, and request chain
steps.expected: The guest sees the authorized booking surface without token exposure or auth bounce
steps.observed: Visible result was the guest sign-in page ('Sign in to your account'). No page errors were reported. Network captured the chain /dev/booking-recovery -> /bookings/recover?access_token=<redacted>&next=... -> /bookings/22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222 -> /auth/signin?redirectedFrom=%2Fbookings%2Frecover%3Fnext%3D...

assertions.issues: Recovery token was stripped before the final URL, but the flow failed the assertion because success did not reach a token-free entitled destination; it bounced to sign-in instead.

frictions.description: agent-browser's network log did not preserve the initial redirect request details for the thank-you canonicalization check after the first navigation completed.
frictions.resolution: Used the required captured start URL, final URL, and rendered confirmation destination as redirect continuity evidence for VAL-FOUNDATION-010.

summary: Tested 2 assertions on the live localhost guest surface: VAL-FOUNDATION-010 passed; VAL-BOOKING-013 failed because recovery redirected to sign-in instead of remaining on an entitled token-free booking detail destination.
